about.description: Generate text, images, video, speech, and music by MiniMax.
about.head: ae29aae

name: v1.0.29
body:
## Highlights

- Add MiniMax-H3-Image support to `mmx image generate`, including text-to-image (`--aspect-ratio`/`--area` or `--size`) and image editing with `--image` (1–16 references).
- Support 768P resolution for MiniMax-H3 video generation.
- `mmx agent setup` now keeps only MiniMax-M3.1 and MiniMax-M3, adds Zed setup, and defaults pay-as-you-go keys to `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash`. The model id is renamed from `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview` to `MiniMax-M3.1-Flash`.
- Fix OAuth refresh coalescing and resource URL scoping, stop polling sleeps at the remaining deadline, and choose speech SDK sample rates from the audio format.

## What's Changed
* fix: coalesce concurrent automatic OAuth refreshes by @ch-z-hc in https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/pull/291
* fix: stop polling sleeps at the remaining deadline by @ch-z-hc in https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/pull/283
* fix: scope OAuth resource URL to OAuth credentials by @ch-z-hc in https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/pull/284
* feat(agent): keep only M3.1 and M3 in agent setup models by @SaladDay in https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/pull/293
* fix(agent): rename model id to MiniMax-M3.1-Flash by @SaladDay in https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/pull/294
* fix(agent): send effort for omp M3.1 Flash low/medium/high by @SaladDay in https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/pull/295
* feat(agent): add Zed agent setup by @SaladDay in https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/pull/297
* fix(agent): declare MiniMax native effort levels and no temperature for Pi and OpenCode by @SaladDay in https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/pull/298
* feat(agent): default pay-as-you-go keys to MiniMax-M3.1-Flash by @SaladDay in https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/pull/296
* fix: choose speech SDK sample rate from audio format by @Ricardo-M-L in https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/pull/305
* feat(video): support 768P resolution for MiniMax-H3 by @gamebody in https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/pull/303
* feat: support MiniMax-H3-Image generation and editing by @jellyjelly814 in https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/pull/306

## New Contributors
* @ch-z-hc made their first contribution in https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/pull/291
* @gamebody made their first contribution in https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/pull/303

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/cli/compare/v1.0.28...v1.0.29
